guides.title: Turing AEM Search: What Your AEM Site Could Do If Search Actually Understood People
guides.description: Your AEM search box is the most honest feedback channel you own, and usually the most neglected. Hybrid search plus a conversational layer over the AEM content you already published, with citations, self-hosted and Apache 2.0.

guides.title: RAG Over Enterprise Content with Viglet Turing and MCP
guides.description: Combine retrieval-augmented generation over your indexed enterprise content with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), so AI agents can search your AEM, WordPress, and database content as a first-class tool.

guides.title: Semantic & Vector Search in Adobe AEM with Viglet Turing
guides.description: Go beyond keyword search on Adobe Experience Manager content: add embedding-based vector search and semantic navigation with an open-source platform, on your own infrastructure.

guides.title: When to Choose Apache Solr, Elasticsearch, or Viglet Turing
guides.description: Raw Solr and Elasticsearch are search engines; Viglet Turing is an enterprise search platform built on top of them. Here's how to decide which layer you actually need.

guides.title: Coveo vs. Lucidworks Fusion (and an Open-Source Option)
guides.description: Coveo is managed SaaS priced per query; Lucidworks Fusion is licensed, Solr-based and runs in your perimeter. How they compare on pricing, data residency, connectors and RAG, plus Viglet Turing as the open-source alternative.

guides.title: Adding Enterprise Search to WordPress with Viglet Turing
guides.description: Index WordPress posts, pages, and custom post types into an open-source enterprise search engine with faceted navigation and semantic search: a self-hosted alternative to Algolia and ElasticPress.

guides.title: Open-Source Alternatives to Algolia and Coveo for Adobe AEM
guides.description: Comparing search options for Adobe Experience Manager: Algolia, Coveo, Lucidworks, raw Solr/Elasticsearch, and the open-source Viglet Turing. Pricing model, data residency, facets, semantic search, and RAG.

guides.title: How to Add Enterprise Search to Adobe AEM with Viglet Turing
guides.description: A step-by-step guide to indexing Adobe Experience Manager content into an open-source enterprise search engine with faceted navigation, semantic search, and RAG: an alternative to Algolia, Coveo, and Lucidworks.
